description: Send selected editor file contents to the SimplyScan Security Engine's deterministic repository rules. Requires a Pro API key. Source leaves the editor, is processed in memory, and is not retained; masked findings are saved in the private scan record. No AI provider receives these files. Code rules analyse JavaScript and TypeScript; other files are checked for secrets only. When no file can be analysed, the result has no score.
name: scan_local_code
title: Scan local code
